articles.summary: SHANGHAI, May 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Yum China Holdings, Inc. (the "Company" or " Yum China ") (NYSE: YUMC and HKEX: 9987) announced that KFC's light-meal concept, KPRO, has surpassed 300 locations in China and is on track to reach 600 locations by year–end, up from just over 200 in 2025.
articles.title: KFC's KPRO Tops 300 Locations in China
